data.one_liner: iOS implementation of the Flutter camera plugin providing preview, photo, and video capture.
data.what_it_does: Implements the camera plugin for iOS, adding features like zero‑shutter‑lag still capture, custom video output paths, and video rotation handling. It works behind the scenes when you use the federated `camera` package on iOS.
use_when: You require zero‑shutter‑lag photos or custom video file paths
You are using the federated `camera` plugin and want the iOS implementation
avoid_when: Your app targets only Android/Web and doesn't need iOS support
You don't need advanced iOS camera features and prefer a single cross‑platform package
strengths: Full iOS support with latest iOS 17 features
Endorsed federated plugin – automatically included with `camera`
Allows custom video output paths and zero‑shutter‑lag capture
weaknesses: iOS‑only – no effect on Android or Web
Requires manual Info.plist changes for file‑browser visibility
Depends on the main `camera` package for a complete solution
data.setup_notes: If using custom video output paths, add LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace and UISupportsDocumentBrowser keys (set to true) in ios/Runner/Info.plist.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Cross‑platform camera plugin that includes iOS, Android, and Web implementations
